modules.title: Baseline-Entfernung, Bandpass, Notch, Frequenzgang
modules.summary: Implemented ekg.preprocessing.filters (remove_baseline, bandpass, notch, preprocess, frequency_response) per INTERFACES.md with 16 fast unit tests (synthetic sines + sanity on real record 100).
decisions: Baseline: cascaded scipy.ndimage.median_filter 200 ms (73 samples) then 600 ms (217 samples) @360 Hz, odd kernels, mode=reflect (avoids medfilt zero-padding edge artefacts); ~0.07 s for 650000 samples
Bandpass: butter(order,[low,high],band,fs,sos)+sosfiltfilt (zero-phase); notch: iirnotch+filtfilt; inputs coerced to 1-D float64, ValueError on 2-D or invalid band
preprocess returns float32 with same length: baseline -> bandpass 0.5-40 Hz [-> notch 60 Hz]

frequency_response: n points linspace(0, fs/2) inclusive; gain_db = one-way |H| in dB (clipped at -200 dB to avoid -inf in JSON); extra keys gain_db_zero_phase = 2*gain_db (filtfilt squares magnitude) and fs

history.note: frequency_response returns additive extra keys 'gain_db_zero_phase' (as instructed) and 'fs' beyond the INTERFACES.md minimum; gain_db clipped at -200 dB at exact zeros (0 Hz, fs/2) for valid JSON.

modules.title: Pan-Tompkins R-Zacken-Detektion + Validierung
modules.summary: Pan-Tompkins (1985) R-peak detector: zero-phase Butterworth 5-15 Hz band-pass -> centred 5-point derivative -> squaring -> centred 150 ms moving-window integration -> adaptive SPKI/NPKI thresholds with 200 ms refractory, 360 ms T-wave slope discrimination and search-back at 166% of mean RR. pan_tompkins_stages returns the 4 aligned intermediate signals; match_peaks does greedy nearest-first 1:1 matching. Validated on real MIT-BIH record 100 (MLII, read directly with wfdb, 2273 reference beats N/A/V): tol 150 ms -> TP 2273, FP 0, FN 0 (Se 1.0, PPV 1.0); tol 20 ms also Se/PPV 1.0; median offset to annotation +1 sample, max 3 samples. Single record only - not a database-level benchmark.
decisions: Zero-phase (forward-backward) filtering and centred derivative/integration instead of the causal integer filters of the paper: no group delay, stages aligned with input.

Final R position = sample with max |x - median(window)| of the INPUT signal within +/-75 ms of the integrated-signal fiducial mark (not |bandpassed|): lands on the R apex as in MIT-BIH annotations, polarity-independent.
Thresholds only on the integrated signal (no second band-pass threshold set); learning phase = first 2 s (SPKI=0.25*max, NPKI=0.5*mean).
Mean RR = mean of last 8 RR within 92-116% of running mean (RR AVERAGE2), fallback plain mean of last 8 RR.
match_peaks: undefined ratios (no reference / no detections) reported as 0.0 to stay JSON-serialisable; tolerance boundary inclusive.
Degenerate input (len<5, constant, non-finite) returns empty int64 array; 2-D input raises ValueError.
tests: record 100 MLII tol150: tp=2273 fp=0 fn=0 Se=1.0 PPV=1.0

modules.title: Beat-Fenster, RR-Features, BeatSet
modules.summary: segment_beats/rr_features/BeatSet/build_beat_dataset implemented per INTERFACES.md. Record 100: 2273 beat annotations -> 2271 beats (2 edge beats dropped), shape (2271,252), labels N=2237 S=33 V=1 (matches A=33, V=1 annotations), RR 0.52-1.13 s.
decisions: Window [r-90, r+162) derived from pre_ms/post_ms and fs (round); beats whose window leaves the signal are dropped; segment_beats does no normalisation.

RR features computed per record on ALL beat peaks (incl. edge beats dropped later) then indexed by kept beats; non-beat annotations (+, ~, ...) are never RR neighbours; no cross-record window (no leakage).
pre_rr of first beat := post_rr, post_rr of last := pre_rr; local_rr = causal mean of last <=10 pre_rr incl. current (cumsum); single beat -> zeros, ratio 1; non-increasing peaks raise ValueError.
Per-beat z-normalisation in build_beat_dataset (flat beats -> zeros, eps 1e-6).
Detected-peak mode: RR on full detected sequence (as a deployed detector sees it), one-to-one nearest-annotation matching within 150 ms, unmatched detections dropped.

history.note: Additive extras beyond contract (no signature changes): window_samples(fs,pre_ms,post_ms)->(pre,post), znormalize(beats), BeatSet.empty(length), BeatSet.__len__, constants LOCAL_RR_BEATS=10, MATCH_TOL_MS=150. BeatSet.concat([]) returns an empty BeatSet (L=252).

modules.title: PyTorch 1D-CNN mit RR-Fusion + Architektur-Beschreibung
modules.summary: ECGNet1D (PyTorch): 3 Conv-Bloecke (16/32/64 Kanaele, Kernel 7/5/3, padding=same, BN, ReLU, MaxPool2) -> GAP (64) + RR-Zweig BN(4)->Linear(4,16)->ReLU, Fusion 80 -> Linear(80,64)->ReLU->Dropout(0.3)->Linear(64,C). 14749 trainierbare Parameter (Default-Konfiguration). describe_architecture misst Output-Shapes per Forward-Hooks.
decisions: RR-BatchNorm als _SafeBatchNorm1d (in describe als Typ 'BatchNorm1d'): bei Trainings-Batch der Groesse 1 werden Running-Stats verwendet (kein Crash bei letztem Mini-Batch der Groesse 1)
rr=None -> Null-Tensor (B,4); Eingabe (B,L) wird zu (B,1,L) erweitert; andere Shapes -> ValueError
Konkatenation als parameterfreies Modul 'concat' (hookbar), damit describe_architecture die Fusion (1,80) zeigt

describe_architecture: Layer-Namen = qualifizierte Modulnamen (features.conv1, rr_branch.fc, concat, head.fc2), Pseudo-Layer 'input' [1,1,L] und 'rr_input' [1,4]; output_shape inkl. Batch-Dim 1; Ausfuehrungsreihenfolge; eval-Modus, Trainingsmodus wird wiederhergestellt; Summe params == count_parameters
count_parameters zaehlt nur trainierbare Parameter (requires_grad)

modules.title: Interpretierbarer Entscheidungsbaum + JSON/Mermaid-Export
modules.summary: Interpretable decision-tree baseline: 7 morphology features (qrs_width_ms, r_amplitude, q_depth, s_depth, qrs_area, t_amplitude, beat_energy) + 4 RR features, CART training with balanced class weights, nested JSON export and Mermaid flowchart TD rendering.
decisions: qrs_width_ms: |derivative| dilated by 25 ms moving max, threshold 15% of peak in [R-100ms, R+150ms], contiguous run containing R; dilation length subtracted
beat_energy = fraction of total beat energy in [R-50ms, R+100ms] (absolute energy is constant under z-normalisation)
q_depth/s_depth are signed minima (more negative = deeper); amplitudes in z-units; qrs_area in z*ms

export_tree: value = normalised (class-weighted) distribution aligned with class_names, samples = n_node_samples (raw counts not recoverable with balanced weights), id = sklearn node index (int), extra key impurity; left = feature <= threshold
tree.classes_ mapped onto class_names by label id (supports subsets such as only N/S/V present)
extract_features(rr=None) returns morphology features only; optional keyword r_index (default round(0.25*fs)=90)
tree_to_mermaid: one line per node, leaves as stadium shape 'Klasse X (n=..)', edges ja (left) / nein (right), ids 'n'+sanitised id, quotes escaped as #quot;

history.note: Additive extensions to INTERFACES signature: extract_features accepts rr=None and keyword-only r_index; export_tree nodes carry extra key 'impurity'; 'id' is an int (sklearn node index).

modules.title: Trainingsschleife, Klassengewichte, Checkpoints
modules.summary: ekg.training.train: BeatTorchDataset, class_weights, train_cnn (Adam + class-weighted CE, deterministic, optional best-checkpoint/early stopping on val_macro_f1), predict/predict_logits, save_model/load_model (state_dict + constructor config).
decisions: class_weights: inverse frequency normalised to mean 1 over present classes; classes with zero training support get weight 0

Determinism: random/numpy/torch seeded, torch.set_num_threads(min(4, cpu_count)), shuffling via dedicated seeded torch.Generator, manual index batching (no DataLoader workers); identical history+weights for same seed verified in tests

Model selection: with val, best epoch by val_macro_f1 (earliest on ties) is restored (restore_best=True); optional early stopping via patience. val MUST be built from held-out DS1 records, never from DS2 (documented in module + train_cnn docstring)
Losses reported as class-weighted mean CE (training weights) over all beats; val_loss None instead of NaN so history stays strict JSON
Checkpoint format: torch.save dict {format:'ekg.ECGNet1D', version:1, config, class_names, state_dict}; load_model uses weights_only=True and rejects foreign files
tests: .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_train.py: 11 passed in ~5 s (synthetic beats only; separable 3-class set reaches val macro-F1 > 0.9, save/load logits identical)

history.note: Contract extension (backward compatible): train_cnn has extra keyword-only params patience=None, restore_best=True, weight_decay=0.0, model_kwargs=None, on_epoch=None; history entries additionally contain val_accuracy, lr, best; extra helpers set_determinism(seed) and predict_logits(model, data). load_model(path, map_location='cpu'). val_loss is None (not NaN) without val or if val has only classes absent in train.

modules.title: Konfusionsmatrix, Sens/PPV/Spez/F1 nach AAMI EC57
modules.summary: AAMI-EC57-Metriken implementiert: confusion (rows=true, cols=pred, int64, Eingabevalidierung), per_class_metrics (Se/PPV/Sp/F1 one-vs-rest + support + tp/fp/fn/tn), summary (JSON-serialisierbar, reine Python-Typen), optionale gross_statistics (gross=gepoolt, average=Mittel pro Record).
decisions: Division durch 0 ergibt 0.0 (nie NaN), damit JSON-serialisierbar und vergleichbar
macro_f1 = ungewichtetes Mittel der F1 nur ueber Klassen mit support>0; ohne unterstuetzte Klasse 0.0
accuracy bei leerer Eingabe = 0.0
gross_statistics: average mittelt pro Metrik nur ueber Records mit Nenner>0 (n_records_<metric> wird mitgeliefert)
EC57-VEB-Konvention optional (default an): echte F-Beats als V klassifiziert zaehlen nicht als FP (und nicht als TN) fuer V; Klasse F selbst unveraendert

history.note: Additive contract extension: per_class entries also contain raw counts tp/fp/fn/tn; summary has extra key 'n' (total beats); new optional function gross_statistics(per_record, class_names, veb_ignore_fusion=True). All INTERFACES.md keys unchanged.

modules.title: End-to-End-Pipeline, Web-Export, Makefile, README
modules.summary: Integrated wave 1: full suite green (175 passed). New CLI src/ekg/pipeline.py (demo/prepare/train/smoke/export-state), tests/test_pipeline.py (13 tests), Makefile, README.md (German). make demo filled web/public/data from REAL record 100 (10-s window 1513.9-1523.9 s containing the record's single V beat; 12 N + 12 S + 1 V real beats; architecture of a fresh ECGNet1D, 14,749 params; log-spaced filter response); metrics.json and dataset_stats.json status 'pending' with German reason, no tree.json. Measured Pan-Tompkins on whole record 100 vs reference annotations (tol 150 ms): TP 2273, FP 0, FN 0, sensitivity 1.0, PPV 1.0 - single record, not a benchmark. make smoke OK (artifacts/smoke only). train/prepare exit 2 with list of missing DS1/DS2 records (physionet.org blocked).
decisions: R peaks for the demo are detected on the preprocessed signal (same input as build_beat_dataset); Pan-Tompkins stages computed on the whole record and sliced to the window (no filter edge effects).
Demo window chosen automatically: windows centred on each non-N beat, score = sum of 1/count(class) of non-N beats inside -> record 100's single V beat; --start-s overrides.

train: CNN trained on DS1 minus a record-wise validation hold-out of 4 DS1 records (seeded draw that keeps N/S/V in val and all classes in train; --val-records overrides); early stopping patience 5 on val macro-F1; tree trained on all DS1 beats (no tuning); both evaluated on DS2 only; gross EC57 statistics added.
prepare caches one npz per record (artifacts/beats/<rec>_ref.npz) keyed by version, window and file size/mtime; reference annotations as R peaks by default (--detected-peaks for Pan-Tompkins).
Smoke: record 100 split in time 60/20/20, 1 epoch, outputs smoke_*.json with status 'smoke' and an explicit warning, refuses any path under web/.
frequency_response extended (keyword-only log_spaced/f_min) so the UI gets log-spaced frequencies; default behaviour unchanged.
tests: make demo: 7 files in web/public/data; record-100 R-peak detection tp=2273 fp=0 fn=0 sens=1.0 ppv=1.0
make smoke: OK (cache roundtrip, model reload identical logits, 1 epoch history, tree export)

decisions: STEPS[].phase holds the display label (shell renders it verbatim); PHASES[].id equals that label, PHASES[].label is the long name
dataFile set only on steps with a panel and always identical to the PANELS mapping in views/process.js
No model metrics anywhere; record-100 facts (MLII/V5, 2239 N, 33 A, 1 V) verified from data/sample/100.hea/.atr; record 100 noted as DS2 member, demo only
Pan-Tompkins text documents deviations of rpeaks.py from the 1985 original (zero-phase 5-15 Hz, centred derivative, +/-75 ms refinement)
tests: node scratchpad validator (ids/order, phases, required fields, panel/diagram/dataFile/codeRef against required IDs, allowed tags only, balanced HTML, no inline styles): OK

modules.title: Build, Verdrahtung, Screenshot-Verifikation (Light/Dark/Mobile)
modules.summary: UI integrated and verified end to end: npm run build passes; FastAPI serves web/dist; Playwright on #/, #/process, #/status in light+dark at 1440px and 375px: 0 console errors, 0 page errors, 0 HTTP>=400, 7/7 Mermaid diagrams rendered (no error SVGs), 6 panels with real Record-100 data + 3 clean pending empty states (training, confusion, tree) + dataset pending, no horizontal page overflow. Interaction suite 22/22 (theme toggle + diagram re-theme, persistence, scrollspy, TOC/phase/deep-link navigation, mobile menu + step dropdown). Visual polish: two-column Process intro with phase navigator, overview pipeline stage list next to diagram, min:s time axes, readable pending reasons with inline code, diagram scroll hint on mobile, wrapping card titles, more opaque sticky bars, correct scroll offsets. Screenshots in docs/screenshots/.
decisions: Status view prefers live /api/state over the exported snapshot so the Agenten-Status page is current when served by FastAPI.
tree.json fetch is gated on metrics.json status=complete (tree only exists after full DS1 training) to avoid 404s in the console.
ECG/Pan-Tompkins time axes use min:s (25:14) instead of seconds (1.514), which German readers misread as a thousands separator.
Overview R-peak tile hint now says 'gesamter Record 100 (2.273 Referenz-Schlaege)' as detection.scope='record' (pipeline note).
Full-page desktop Process screenshot taken at deviceScaleFactor 0.5: Chromium blanks full-page captures taller than ~16k device px.
Architecture chain auto-fits to width only when scaling >= 62 %; otherwise it scrolls inside its card (readable text over fit).
tests: cd web && npm run build: ok (11.6 s)
playwright check (3 routes x light/dark x 1440/375 against FastAPI :8000): 0 problems

history.note: Status view now reads live /api/state first and falls back to data/project_state.json (snapshot) only for static hosting; on a static host without API the /api/state 404 appears once in the console.
PANELS.tree gains gate:'metrics.json': tree.json is only fetched when metrics.json status is complete (avoids 404 console errors while training is pending); empty state shows the pipeline reason.

modules.title: Adversariales Review: ML-Korrektheit, Tests, UI, Ehrlichkeit der Aussagen
modules.summary: Fix agent: verified all 17 review findings (all reproducible), fixed all 17. Pan-Tompkins threshold recovery, QRS width incl. Q/S, capped class weights + macro_f1_nsvf, cache key with code hash, smoke .hea paths, constraints.txt, API 503 for unreadable state + state.py 0644, train -> <out>/web, tests for state.py/download CLI, UI honesty texts (201/202 same person, reference-peak segmentation, detector claim, layer count, gallery counts), legible mobile Mermaid diagrams.
decisions: rpeaks: re-learn thresholds on the next 2 s of the integrated signal after max(2 s, 1.66 RR) without QRS, only if max/median > 10 (QRS bursts >= 36x on record 100, white noise 3-6x) so sinus pauses do not pull thresholds to the noise floor; search-back retried afterwards
qrs_width_ms: threshold max(5% of dilated |deriv| peak, 4x PR-segment median |deriv|) instead of 15%; record 100 N median 72 ms (was 50)
local_rr kept causal incl. current beat (contract unchanged); only docs/UI wording corrected
class_weights capped at 50x majority-class weight (max_ratio kwarg, None = old behaviour); summary() adds macro_f1_nsvf
beat cache meta includes SHA-256 of loader/filters/rpeaks/segmentation source
artifacts/web kept as API fallback and now filled by pipeline train (<out>/web)
constraints.txt = pip freeze of tested venv, used by make install; CPU torch wheel via PIP_EXTRA (not verified here: download.pytorch.org unreachable)
tests: python -m ekg.pipeline demo: ok, record 100 TP=2273 FP=0 FN=0
cd web && npm run build: ok
playwright #/process light+dark 1440px and 375px: 0 console errors, no page h-scroll, mobile Mermaid text 11.9 px (was 6-9 px)

history.note: Contract change ekg.training.train.class_weights: new kwarg max_ratio=50.0 (default caps rare-class weights at 50x the majority-class weight; max_ratio=None = old pure inverse frequency). INTERFACES.md updated.

Contract extension ekg.evaluation.metrics.summary: additional key macro_f1_nsvf (macro-F1 over N/S/V/F, Q excluded); existing keys unchanged. pipeline train now writes web JSONs to <out>/web (= artifacts/web, the API fallback) instead of <out>/; model.pt stays in <out>/. metrics.json config gains library_versions and preprocessing_fingerprint.

Feature semantics changed: qrs_width_ms now includes Q/S waves (5% derivative threshold + PR-noise floor; record 100 N median 72 ms instead of 50 ms). Pan-Tompkins got a threshold re-learning step (documented in rpeaks.py). Beat caches are keyed by a source hash of loader/filters/rpeaks/segmentation, so old .npz caches are rebuilt.
